decisions.choice: the chapter: the ruler of Tyre, a lament over its king, Sidon, and a promise to Israel
decisions.reason: Verses 2-10 condemn the ruler of Tyre for claiming to be a god. Verses 11-19 are a lament over the king of Tyre, pictured in the garden of Eden. Verses 20-23 are a short oracle against Sidon, and verses 24-26 close the oracles against Israel's neighbors with a promise to Israel.

decisions.reason: The settled formula, as in 1:3.

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, say to [the] ruler of Tyre, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because your heart is proud, and you have said, A god [am] I; [the] seat of gods I sit [in], in [the] heart of [the] seas; but you [are] a human and not a god, and you have made your heart like [the] heart of a god,

en.L: Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because your heart is proud, and you have said, "A god [am] I; [in] the seat of gods I sit, in the heart of the seas," yet you [are] a mortal and not a god, though you have made your heart like the heart of a god,
en.B: Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: You are proud at heart, and you have claimed, "I am a god! I sit on the throne of the gods in the heart of the seas." Yet you are a mortal and not a god, though you count your mind equal to the mind of a god.
en.R: Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: You are proud. You have said, "I am a god. I sit on the throne of the gods in the middle of the sea." But you are only a human being, not a god, even though you think you are as wise as a god.

fr.L: Fils d’homme, dis au prince de Tyr : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que ton cœur s’est élevé, et que tu as dit : « Un dieu, [c’est] moi ; [sur] le siège des dieux je suis assis, au cœur des mers », alors que tu [es] un homme et non un dieu, bien que tu aies rendu ton cœur pareil au cœur d’un dieu,
fr.B: Fils d’homme, dis au prince de Tyr : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ton cœur est plein d’orgueil, et tu as prétendu : « Je suis un dieu ! Je siège sur le trône des dieux, au cœur des mers. » Pourtant tu es un homme et non un dieu, même si tu estimes ton intelligence égale à celle d’un dieu.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, dis au souverain de Tyr : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Tu es orgueilleux. Tu as dit : « Je suis un dieu. Je suis assis sur le trône des dieux, au milieu de la mer. » Mais tu n’es qu’un être humain, pas un dieu, même si tu penses être aussi sage qu’un dieu.

es.L: Hijo de hombre, di al príncipe de Tiro: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto tu corazón se ha enaltecido, y has dicho: «Un dios [soy] yo; [en] el trono de los dioses estoy sentado, en el corazón de los mares», siendo tú un mortal y no un dios, aunque has puesto tu corazón como el corazón de un dios,
es.B: Hijo de hombre, di al príncipe de Tiro: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Tu corazón es orgulloso, y has afirmado: «¡Soy un dios! Estoy sentado en el trono de los dioses, en el corazón de los mares». Pero tú eres un mortal y no un dios, aunque te crees tan sabio como un dios.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, dile al gobernante de Tiro: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Eres orgulloso. Has dicho: «Soy un dios. Estoy sentado en el trono de los dioses en medio del mar». Pero no eres más que un ser humano, no un dios, aunque pienses que eres tan sabio como un dios.

sw.B: Mwana wa binadamu, mwambie mkuu wa Tiro, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Moyo wako umejaa kiburi, nawe umejidai, "Mimi ni mungu! Ninaketi katika kiti cha enzi cha miungu katikati ya bahari." Lakini wewe ni binadamu tu, wala si mungu, ingawa unajiona kuwa na akili sawa na akili ya mungu.
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, mwambie mtawala wa Tiro, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Una kiburi. Umesema, "Mimi ni mungu. Ninaketi katika kiti cha enzi cha miungu katikati ya bahari." Lakini wewe ni mwanadamu tu, si mungu, ingawa unadhani una hekima kama mungu.

decisions.choice: son of man: a mortal, as God addresses Ezekiel
decisions.reason: See the note at 2:1.

decisions.choice: the prince of Tyre: the ruler of Tyre, its king
decisions.reason: The word (*nagid*) means a leader or ruler. Verse 12 calls the same ruler "the king of Tyre". The king of Tyre in Ezekiel's day was Ittobaal III (stated from general knowledge); the oracle does not name him, and speaks to the office as much as to the man.

decisions.choice: I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods: the ruler claims divine rank
decisions.reason: Kings in the ancient world often claimed to be divine or to sit among the gods. Tyre's island throne, "in the heart of the seas", seemed out of reach of any enemy. The LORD answers that he is a mortal, a claim tested in verse 9 when his killer stands before him.

decisions.choice: the seat of gods: a divine throne
decisions.reason: The word for "gods" (*elohim*) can also mean God. The ruler claims a seat among the gods, or the very seat of God.

decisions.choice: you have made your heart like the heart of a god: you think yourself as wise as a god
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the heart is the mind and will. He counts his own understanding divine (verses 3-5).

decisions.choice: a mortal (L, B); only a human being (R)
decisions.reason: *'Adam* set against God follows the settled wording ("mortal" / "human beings"). It refers to one man here, so it takes no gender setting. *Nagid* is "prince" at Literal and Balanced and "ruler" at Readable, matching the wording for *nasi'*.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula. The LORD's words take no quotation marks; human speech quoted inside them takes double quotes.

decisions.choice: el príncipe (L, B); el gobernante (R) de Tiro; masculine 'tú'
decisions.reason: The ruler (nagid) of Tyre is worded as the English does at each level; a king addressed directly takes masculine 'tú'.

decisions.choice: un mortal (L, B); no eres más que un ser humano (R)
decisions.reason: 'Adam' against 'el' sets a mortal against a god; Spanish says it plainly, with no gender span since one man is meant.

decisions.choice: *nagid* "le prince de Tyr" (L, B); "le souverain de Tyr" (R); the ruler is addressed in the masculine through 28:19
decisions.reason: The term sheet: the king of Tyre is masculine, unlike the city in 26-27; "souverain" says plainly at R that he is its king.

decisions.choice: "mkuu wa Tiro" (L, B); "mtawala wa Tiro" (R); "mungu", lowercase, for the god the ruler claims to be
decisions.reason: The nagid of Tyre is its king; "mkuu" here is the ordinary word for a ruler, as "wakuu wa bahari" in 26:16. Lowercase "mungu" marks the ruler's claim to divine rank, as the English "a god".

decisions.choice: Daniel: the ancient wise man Danel, or the Daniel of the book
decisions.reason: See the note at 14:14. The written Hebrew again spells the name Dan'el. The famous wise man of old fits a saying addressed to a Phoenician king.

decisions.choice: you are wiser than Daniel: said with irony
decisions.reason: The LORD repeats the ruler's own high opinion of himself, in order to bring it down.

decisions.choice: no secret is hidden from you
decisions.reason: The verb is rare and seems to mean "be dark to" or "be a match for". No secret is beyond him.

decisions.choice: You think you are
decisions.reason: Readable makes the irony plain (m2).

decisions.choice: "Danieli"
decisions.reason: As the Swahili Ezekiel 14:14; the meaning decision gives the two readings.

decisions.reason: Here wisdom is practical skill, the cleverness that made Tyre rich through trade (verse 5).

records.literal_gloss: by [the] greatness of your wisdom in your trade you have increased your wealth, and your heart has become proud in your wealth.

en.L: by the greatness of your wisdom in your trade you have increased your wealth, and your heart has become proud because of your wealth.
en.B: By your great skill in trading you have multiplied your wealth, and your wealth has made your heart proud.
en.R: You were so good at trading that you became richer and richer. And because you were rich, you became proud.

fr.L: par la grandeur de ta sagesse dans ton commerce tu as multiplié tes richesses, et ton cœur s’est élevé à cause de tes richesses.
fr.B: Par ta grande habileté dans le commerce, tu as multiplié tes richesses, et tes richesses ont rempli ton cœur d’orgueil.
fr.R: Tu étais si doué pour le commerce que tu es devenu de plus en plus riche. Et parce que tu étais riche, tu es devenu orgueilleux.

es.L: con la grandeza de tu sabiduría en tu comercio has multiplicado tus riquezas, y se ha enaltecido tu corazón a causa de tus riquezas.
es.B: Con tu gran habilidad para el comercio has multiplicado tus riquezas, y tus riquezas han llenado de orgullo tu corazón.
es.R: Eras tan bueno para el comercio que te hiciste cada vez más rico. Y como eras rico, te volviste orgulloso.

sw.L: kwa wingi wa hekima yako katika biashara yako umeongeza mali yako, na moyo wako umejivuna kwa sababu ya mali yako.
sw.B: Kwa ustadi wako mkubwa katika biashara umeongeza utajiri wako mara nyingi, na utajiri wako umeufanya moyo wako kujaa kiburi.
sw.R: Ulikuwa hodari sana katika biashara hata ukazidi kutajirika. Na kwa sababu ulikuwa tajiri, ukawa na kiburi.

decisions.choice: your heart has become proud because of your wealth
decisions.reason: Riches lead to pride and to forgetting God (Deuteronomy 8:13-14; Hosea 13:6). Verses 3-5 explain how the ruler came to say "I am a god" (verse 2).

en.L: therefore, look, I am bringing strangers upon you, the most ruthless of the nations, and they will unsheathe their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and profane your splendor.
en.B: therefore I am bringing foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations. They will bare their swords against all that your wisdom made beautiful, and they will defile your splendor.
en.R: So I am going to bring foreigners to attack you, from the cruelest nation of all. They will draw their swords against all the beautiful things your wisdom has won, and they will ruin your splendor.

fr.L: c’est pourquoi, voici, je fais venir contre toi des étrangers, les plus terribles des nations, et ils tireront leurs épées contre la beauté de ta sagesse, et ils profaneront ta splendeur.
fr.B: c’est pourquoi je fais venir contre toi des étrangers, les plus impitoyables des nations. Ils tireront l’épée contre tout ce que ta sagesse a rendu beau, et ils souilleront ta splendeur.
fr.R: C’est pourquoi je vais faire venir des étrangers pour t’attaquer, la nation la plus cruelle de toutes. Ils tireront leurs épées contre toutes les belles choses que ta sagesse t’a apportées, et ils détruiront ta splendeur.

es.L: por tanto, he aquí, yo traigo sobre ti extranjeros, los más crueles de las naciones, y desenvainarán sus espadas contra la hermosura de tu sabiduría, y profanarán tu esplendor.
es.B: por eso voy a traer contra ti a extranjeros, la más cruel de las naciones. Desenvainarán sus espadas contra todo lo hermoso que logró tu sabiduría y mancharán tu esplendor.
es.R: Por eso voy a traer extranjeros de la nación más cruel de todas para que te ataquen. Sacarán sus espadas contra todas las cosas hermosas que tu sabiduría te ganó, y arruinarán tu esplendor.

sw.L: kwa hiyo, tazama, ninaleta wageni juu yako, wakatili kuliko wote wa mataifa, nao watazifuta panga zao dhidi ya uzuri wa hekima yako na kuitia unajisi fahari yako.

sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitaleta wageni wakushambulie, kutoka taifa katili kuliko yote. Watafuta panga zao dhidi ya vitu vyote vizuri ulivyopata kwa hekima yako, nao wataiharibu fahari yako.

decisions.choice: the most ruthless of the nations: Babylon
decisions.reason: Ezekiel uses the same words of the Babylonian armies in 30:11, 31:12 and 32:12.

decisions.choice: profane your splendor: treat as common what claimed to be holy
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something holy common or unclean. The "god" of Tyre will be shown to be no god at all.

decisions.choice: all the beautiful things your wisdom has won
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the beauty of your wisdom" is (verses 4-5).

en.L: To the pit they will bring you down, and you will die the deaths of the slain in the heart of the seas.
en.B: They will thrust you down into the pit, and you will be slain and die in the heart of the seas.
en.R: They will send you down to the pit, the world of the dead. You will die a violent death out in the sea.

fr.L: Dans la fosse ils te feront descendre, et tu mourras de la mort des tués au cœur des mers.
fr.B: Ils te précipiteront dans la fosse, et tu mourras d’une mort violente au cœur des mers.
fr.R: Ils t’enverront en bas, dans la fosse, le monde des morts. Tu mourras d’une mort violente au milieu de la mer.

es.L: A la fosa te harán descender, y morirás con las muertes de los traspasados en el corazón de los mares.
es.B: Te arrojarán a la fosa, y morirás de muerte violenta en el corazón de los mares.
es.R: Te enviarán abajo, a la fosa, al mundo de los muertos. Morirás de una muerte violenta mar adentro.

sw.L: Watakushusha shimoni, nawe utakufa vifo vya waliouawa katika moyo wa bahari.
sw.B: Watakutupa chini shimoni, nawe utauawa na kufa katikati ya bahari.
sw.R: Watakupeleka shimoni, ulimwengu wa wafu. Utakufa kifo cha kikatili huko baharini.

decisions.choice: the pit: the world of the dead
the deaths of the slain: a violent death

records.literal_gloss: Will you really say, A god [am] I, before [the one who] kills you? And you [are] a human and not a god in [the] hand of [those who] pierce you.

en.L: Will you really say, "A god [am] I," before the one who kills you? You [are] a mortal and not a god in the hand of those who pierce you.
en.B: Will you still say, "I am a god," when you face the one who kills you? You will be only a mortal, not a god, in the hands of those who strike you down.
en.R: When your killer stands in front of you, will you still say, "I am a god"? No, you will be only a human being, not a god, when they kill you.

Ezekiel uses it again of Pharaoh and the nations in the world of the dead (31:18; 32:19-32).

en.R: Son of man, sing a funeral song about the king of Tyre. \q Say to him, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: \q You were a perfect example, \q full of wisdom and perfectly beautiful.

decisions.choice: son of man: a mortal, as God addresses Ezekiel
decisions.reason: See the note at 2:1.

decisions.choice: a lament over the king of Tyre
decisions.reason: See the note at 19:1. Verses 12-19 are a lament, set in lines as poetry. It tells the king's story as a story of Eden: created perfect, placed in the garden of God, then cast out for his pride and destroyed.

decisions.choice: the king of Tyre in Eden: the text addresses the king; the reading of Satan's fall is later
decisions.reason: The lament speaks to "the king of Tyre", and its charges are his: his wealth and trade (verses 16, 18) and his pride in his beauty and wisdom (verse 17), the same charges as in verses 2-10. To show how far he will fall, it pictures him in the garden of God, like the first man, and as a cherub on God's mountain. From early times some Christian writers read the passage, with Isaiah 14:12-15, as a picture of the fall of Satan, an angel who fell through pride (stated from general knowledge). That reading comes later than the text, which nowhere names Satan or an angel and addresses a human ruler, as Isaiah 14 addresses the king of Babylon (Isaiah 14:4, 16). The wording here translates what the lament says to the king and is not shaped to the later reading.

decisions.choice: the seal of the pattern: the model of perfection
decisions.reason: The phrase is obscure. A seal bore a design and stamped it; "seal of a pattern" seems to mean the finished model, the sum of perfection. It may also mean "sealing (completing) the measure".

decisions.choice: no quotation marks; set in lines; funeral song (R)
decisions.reason: The lament is what Ezekiel is told to say, so it takes no quotation marks under the quotation rule for Ezekiel. The lines follow the Hebrew accents. Readable says "funeral song" for *qinah*, as in 19:1.

decisions.choice: the lament in lines, with no quotation marks; masculine 'tú'
decisions.reason: The lament over the king of Tyre (12b-19) is set in lines, as the English does; it is God's message, so it takes no quotation marks. The king is addressed with masculine 'tú'.

decisions.choice: the lament over the king of Tyre (12b-19) in lines and without quotation marks, God speaking to the king in the passé composé and imparfait ("tu étais", "je t'ai jeté")
decisions.reason: The poem is God's speech, so the tenses of speech hold at every level (term sheet).

decisions.choice: "muhuri wa kielelezo" (L); "kielelezo cha ukamilifu" (B); "mfano kamili" (R)
decisions.reason: The obscure Hebrew phrase follows the English levels; the poem is set in lines without quotation marks, as God's message.

source.text: בְּעֵ֨דֶן גַּן־אֱלֹהִ֜ים הָיִ֗יתָ כָּל־אֶ֨בֶן יְקָרָ֤ה מְסֻכָתֶ֨ךָ֙ אֹ֣דֶם פִּטְדָ֞ה וְיָהֲלֹ֗ם תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֨הַם֙ וְיָ֣שְׁפֵ֔ה סַפִּ֣יר נֹ֔פֶךְ וּבָרְקַ֖ת וְזָהָ֑ב מְלֶ֨אכֶת תֻּפֶּ֤יךָ וּנְקָבֶ֨יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּי֥וֹם הִבָּרַאֲךָ֖ כּוֹנָֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: In Eden, [the] garden of God, you were; every precious stone [was] your covering: carnelian, topaz and emerald, chrysolite, onyx and jasper, sapphire, turquoise and beryl, and gold; [the] workmanship of your settings and your sockets [was] in you; on [the] day you were created they were prepared.

en.L: In Eden, the garden of God, you were; every precious stone [was] your covering: carnelian, topaz and emerald, chrysolite, onyx and jasper, \q sapphire, turquoise and beryl, and gold; \q the workmanship of your settings and your sockets [was] in you; \q on the day you were created they were prepared.
en.B: You were in Eden, the garden of God; you were clothed in every precious stone: carnelian, topaz and emerald, chrysolite, onyx and jasper, \q sapphire, turquoise and beryl, and gold. \q Your settings and mountings were crafted for you; \q on the day you were created they were made ready.
en.R: You were in Eden, the garden of God. You were covered with every kind of precious stone: carnelian, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, \q sapphire, turquoise, beryl and gold. \q Beautiful settings were made for your jewels. \q They were made ready on the day you were created.

fr.L: En Éden, le jardin de Dieu, tu étais ; toute pierre précieuse [était] ta couverture : cornaline, topaze et émeraude, chrysolithe, onyx et jaspe, \q saphir, turquoise et béryl, et or ; \q l’ouvrage de tes chatons et de tes montures [était] en toi ; \q au jour où tu as été créé, ils ont été préparés.
fr.B: Tu étais en Éden, le jardin de Dieu ; tu étais vêtu de toutes sortes de pierres précieuses : cornaline, topaze et émeraude, chrysolithe, onyx et jaspe, \q saphir, turquoise et béryl, et or. \q Tes chatons et tes montures étaient travaillés pour toi ; \q au jour où tu as été créé, ils ont été préparés.
fr.R: Tu étais en Éden, le jardin de Dieu. Tu étais couvert de toutes sortes de pierres précieuses : cornaline, topaze, émeraude, chrysolithe, onyx, jaspe, \q saphir, turquoise, béryl et or. \q De belles montures avaient été faites pour tes bijoux. \q Elles ont été préparées le jour où tu as été créé.

es.L: En Edén, el jardín de Dios, estabas; toda piedra preciosa [era] tu vestidura: cornalina, topacio y esmeralda, crisólito, ónice y jaspe, \q zafiro, turquesa y berilo, y oro; \q la obra de tus engastes y de tus monturas [estaba] en ti; \q el día en que fuiste creado fueron preparados.
es.B: Estabas en Edén, el jardín de Dios; te vestías de toda piedra preciosa: cornalina, topacio y esmeralda, crisólito, ónice y jaspe, \q zafiro, turquesa y berilo, y oro. \q Tus engastes y monturas fueron labrados para ti; \q el día en que fuiste creado fueron preparados.
es.R: Estabas en Edén, el jardín de Dios. Te cubrían toda clase de piedras preciosas: cornalina, topacio, esmeralda, crisólito, ónice, jaspe, \q zafiro, turquesa, berilo y oro. \q Para tus joyas se hicieron hermosos engastes. \q Fueron preparados el día en que fuiste creado.

sw.L: Ulikuwa katika Edeni, bustani ya Mungu; kila jiwe la thamani [lilikuwa] kifuniko chako: akiki, topazi na zumaridi, krisolito, onikisi na yaspi, \q yakuti samawi, feruzi na berili, na dhahabu; \q kazi ya vikalio vyako na vitako vyako [ilikuwa] ndani yako; \q siku ile ulipoumbwa viliandaliwa.
sw.B: Ulikuwa katika Edeni, bustani ya Mungu; ulivikwa kila aina ya vito vya thamani: akiki, topazi na zumaridi, krisolito, onikisi na yaspi, \q yakuti samawi, feruzi na berili, na dhahabu. \q Vikalio na vitako vyako vilitengenezwa kwa ustadi kwa ajili yako; \q siku ile ulipoumbwa viliandaliwa.
sw.R: Ulikuwa katika Edeni, bustani ya Mungu. Ulifunikwa kwa kila aina ya vito vya thamani: akiki, topazi, zumaridi, krisolito, onikisi, yaspi, \q yakuti samawi, feruzi, berili na dhahabu. \q Vito vyako viliwekwa katika vikalio vizuri. \q Viliandaliwa siku ile ulipoumbwa.

decisions.choice: Eden, the garden of God: the king pictured as the first man
decisions.reason: Eden is the garden where God placed the first human being (Genesis 2:8-15). Ezekiel calls it "the garden of God" again in 31:8-9 and 36:35. Genesis 2:12 also speaks of gold and precious stone in the land around Eden.

decisions.choice: nine precious stones: nine of the twelve on the high priest's breastpiece
decisions.reason: Each of the nine stones is one of the twelve set on the breastpiece of the high priest (Exodus 28:17-20), though in a different order, and the picture may cast the king as a priestly figure in God's garden. The Greek translation lists all twelve stones, with silver and gold (stated from general knowledge). The names of ancient gems are hard to match with modern ones.

decisions.choice: your settings and your sockets: the jeweler's work
decisions.reason: The first word usually means a tambourine and the second a hole or socket. Here they seem to be terms of the jeweler's craft, the mountings in which the stones were set. Other readings are possible.

decisions.choice: on the day you were created
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for God's creating in Genesis 1:1, 27. The king is spoken of as a creature made by God, as in verse 15.

decisions.choice: carnelian, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, beryl
decisions.reason: The names of the stones follow Exodus 28:17-20 at each level, so that the reader can see that they are the same stones.

decisions.choice: cornalina, topacio, esmeralda, crisólito, ónice, jaspe, zafiro, turquesa, berilo
decisions.reason: The nine stones keep the Spanish names the same Hebrew words have in the high priest's breastpiece (Exodus 28:17-20), so the echo can be seen. Eden is 'Edén' as published.

decisions.choice: "cornaline, topaze, émeraude, chrysolithe, onyx, jaspe, saphir, turquoise, béryl"
decisions.reason: The names of the same stones on the high priest's breastpiece in published French Exodus 28:17-20.

decisions.choice: "akiki, topazi, zumaridi, krisolito, onikisi, yaspi, yakuti samawi, feruzi, berili"
decisions.reason: The names the Swahili Exodus 28:17-20 gives these stones on the high priest's breastpiece, so the allusion stays visible.

source.text: אַ֨תְּ־כְּר֔וּב מִמְשַׁ֖ח הַסּוֹכֵ֑ךְ וּנְתַתִּ֗יךָ בְּהַ֨ר קֹ֤דֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ הָיִ֔יתָ בְּת֥וֹךְ אַבְנֵי־אֵ֖שׁ הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ׃

es.L: Tú [eras] querubín ungido, el protector, \q y yo te puse [allí]; en el santo monte de Dios estabas; \q en medio de las piedras de fuego te paseabas.
es.B: Eras un querubín protector ungido; \q yo te puse allí. Estabas en el santo monte de Dios; \q andabas entre las piedras de fuego.
es.R: Eras un querubín protector, ungido para tu tarea. \q Te puse en el santo monte de Dios. \q Andabas entre las piedras de fuego.

sw.L: Wewe [ulikuwa] kerubi aliyetiwa mafuta, mlinzi, \q nami nilikuweka [hapo]; ulikuwa juu ya mlima mtakatifu wa Mungu; \q katikati ya mawe ya moto ulitembea.
sw.B: Ulikuwa kerubi mlinzi aliyetiwa mafuta; \q nilikuweka hapo. Ulikuwa juu ya mlima mtakatifu wa Mungu; \q ulitembea kati ya mawe ya moto.
sw.R: Ulikuwa kerubi mlinzi, uliyetiwa mafuta kwa kazi yako. \q Nilikuweka juu ya mlima mtakatifu wa Mungu. \q Ulitembea kati ya mawe ya moto.

decisions.choice: a guardian cherub: a winged being who guards God's presence
decisions.reason: Cherubim guarded the way to the tree of life in Eden (Genesis 3:24), and the golden cherubim on the ark spread their wings to cover it (Exodus 25:20, where the same verb, "cover", is used). See the note on cherubim at 10:1.

decisions.choice: you were a cherub
alternatives: with the cherub I placed you
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "you (were) a cherub". The Greek translation, with different vowels, reads "with the cherub I placed you", so that the king is the man in the garden and the cherub is beside him; in verse 16 the Greek has the cherub drive him out (stated from general knowledge). The Hebrew is kept: the king is pictured as the guardian cherub himself.

decisions.choice: anointed
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here. It may mean "anointed", set apart for a task, or come from a root meaning "spread out", picturing the cherub's outspread wings.

decisions.choice: the holy mountain of God, the stones of fire
decisions.reason: Eden is pictured as a mountain, the dwelling of God, as Zion is God's holy mountain (20:40). The "stones of fire" may be the flashing gems of verse 13 or the fiery brightness around God (1:13; Exodus 24:10, 17).

decisions.choice: cherub, at every level
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "cherub", as chapter 10 does. The words are said to the king of Tyre (see the note at verse 12).

decisions.choice: querubín protector (B, R); querubín ungido, el protector (L)
decisions.reason: The cherub keeps the published word 'querubín'; the participle 'covering' is 'protector', the cherub that guards God's presence.

decisions.choice: "un chérubin protecteur"; "chérubin" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "chérubins" at every level; "protecteur" renders the participle "covering".

decisions.choice: "kerubi" at every level, "kerubi mlinzi" for the guardian cherub
decisions.reason: As the Swahili Ezekiel 9:3 and 10.

source.text: תָּמִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בִּדְרָכֶ֔יךָ מִיּ֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָ֑ךְ עַד־נִמְצָ֥א עַוְלָ֖תָה בָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blameless [were] you in your ways from [the] day you were created until was found unrighteousness in you.

en.L: Blameless [were] you in your ways \q from the day you were created, \q until unrighteousness was found in you.
en.B: You were blameless in your ways \q from the day you were created, \q until wickedness was found in you.
en.R: You did what was right in every way \q from the day you were created \q until evil was found in you.

fr.L: Intègre [tu étais] dans tes voies \q depuis le jour où tu as été créé, \q jusqu’à ce que l’injustice se soit trouvée en toi.
fr.B: Tu étais irréprochable dans ta conduite \q depuis le jour où tu as été créé, \q jusqu’à ce que la méchanceté se trouve en toi.
fr.R: Tu faisais ce qui est bien en toutes choses \q depuis le jour où tu as été créé, \q jusqu’à ce que le mal se trouve en toi.

es.L: Perfecto [eras] en tus caminos \q desde el día en que fuiste creado, \q hasta que se halló en ti injusticia.
es.B: Eras intachable en tu conducta \q desde el día en que fuiste creado, \q hasta que se halló maldad en ti.
es.R: Hacías lo correcto en todo \q desde el día en que fuiste creado \q hasta que se encontró maldad en ti.

sw.L: Ulikuwa mkamilifu katika njia zako \q tangu siku ile ulipoumbwa, \q hata uovu ulipoonekana ndani yako.
sw.B: Ulikuwa bila hatia katika njia zako \q tangu siku ile ulipoumbwa, \q mpaka uovu ulipoonekana ndani yako.
sw.R: Ulitenda yaliyo sawa kwa kila njia \q tangu siku ile ulipoumbwa, \q mpaka uovu ulipoonekana ndani yako.

decisions.choice: blameless: whole, without fault
decisions.reason: The word is used of Noah and of the life God asks of Abraham (Genesis 6:9; 17:1).

decisions.choice: until unrighteousness was found in you: the fall
decisions.reason: Like the first human beings, the king began well and fell. Verses 16-18 name the wrong: violence and dishonesty in trade, and pride.

source.text: בְּרֹ֣ב רְכֻלָּתְךָ֗ מָל֧וּ תוֹכְךָ֛ חָמָ֖ס וַֽתֶּחֱטָ֑א וָאֶחַלֶּלְךָ֩ מֵהַ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֤ים וָֽאַבֶּדְךָ֙ כְּר֣וּב הַסֹּכֵ֔ךְ מִתּ֖וֹךְ אַבְנֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] abundance of your trade they filled your midst [with] violence, and you sinned; and I cast you as profane from [the] mountain of God, and I destroyed you, cherub, the covering [one], from [the] midst of [the] stones of fire.

en.L: In the abundance of your trade your midst was filled with violence, and you sinned; \q so I cast you as profane from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, guardian cherub, \q from the midst of the stones of fire.
en.B: Through your vast trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. \q So I threw you in disgrace from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, guardian cherub, \q removing you from among the stones of fire.
en.R: You traded so much that you became full of violence, and you sinned. \q So I threw you off the mountain of God in disgrace. I destroyed you, guardian cherub, \q and took you away from the fiery stones.

fr.L: Par l’abondance de ton commerce on a rempli ton intérieur de violence, et tu as péché ; \q alors je t’ai rejeté comme profane de la montagne de Dieu, et je t’ai fait périr, chérubin protecteur, \q du milieu des pierres de feu.
fr.B: Par ton immense commerce, tu t’es rempli de violence, et tu as péché. \q Alors je t’ai jeté, déshonoré, hors de la montagne de Dieu, et je t’ai fait périr, chérubin protecteur, \q loin des pierres de feu.
fr.R: Tu as tellement fait de commerce que tu es devenu plein de violence, et tu as péché. \q Alors je t’ai jeté hors de la montagne de Dieu, dans la honte. Je t’ai fait périr, chérubin protecteur, \q et je t’ai éloigné des pierres de feu.

es.L: En la abundancia de tu comercio se llenó tu interior de violencia, y pecaste; \q por eso te arrojé como profano del monte de Dios, y te destruí, querubín protector, \q de en medio de las piedras de fuego.
es.B: Con tu enorme comercio te llenaste de violencia y pecaste. \q Por eso te eché deshonrado del monte de Dios, y te destruí, querubín protector, \q y te quité de entre las piedras de fuego.
es.R: Comerciaste tanto que te llenaste de violencia, y pecaste. \q Por eso te eché del monte de Dios en deshonra. Te destruí, querubín protector, \q y te saqué de entre las piedras de fuego.

sw.L: Kwa wingi wa biashara yako katikati yako palijaa udhalimu, nawe ukatenda dhambi; \q kwa hiyo nilikutupa kama kitu kilichonajisika kutoka mlima wa Mungu, nami nikakuangamiza, ewe kerubi mlinzi, \q kutoka katikati ya mawe ya moto.
sw.B: Kwa biashara yako kubwa ulijaa udhalimu, ukatenda dhambi. \q Kwa hiyo nilikutupa kwa aibu kutoka mlima wa Mungu, nikakuangamiza, ewe kerubi mlinzi, \q nikakuondoa kati ya mawe ya moto.
sw.R: Ulifanya biashara nyingi mno hata ukajaa udhalimu, ukatenda dhambi. \q Kwa hiyo nilikutupa kutoka mlima wa Mungu kwa aibu. Nilikuangamiza, ewe kerubi mlinzi, \q nikakuondoa kati ya mawe ya moto.

decisions.choice: trade filled with violence: wealth gained by oppression
decisions.reason: Tyre's trade, which made it great (chapter 27), became violent and unjust: gain at the expense of others, including the slave trade (27:13; Amos 1:9).

decisions.choice: I cast you as profane from the mountain of God
decisions.reason: What is profane cannot stay in a holy place. The king is thrown out as unclean, as the man and woman were sent out of the garden (Genesis 3:23-24).

decisions.choice: and I destroyed you, guardian cherub
alternatives: and the guardian cherub drove you out
decisions.reason: The Greek translation reads "and the cherub drove you out" (stated from general knowledge); see verse 14.

source.text: גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּךָ֙ בְּיָפְיֶ֔ךָ שִׁחַ֥תָּ חָכְמָתְךָ֖ עַל־יִפְעָתֶ֑ךָ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֗יךָ לִפְנֵ֧י מְלָכִ֛ים נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְרַ֥אֲוָה בָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Was proud your heart in your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your splendor; on [the] ground I threw you; before kings I put you, to look at you.

en.L: Your heart was proud because of your beauty; \q you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor; \q to the ground I cast you; before kings I set you, to look at you.
en.B: Your heart grew proud because of your beauty; \q you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor. \q I threw you to the ground; I made you a spectacle before kings.
en.R: You became proud because you were so beautiful. \q You spoiled your wisdom because you loved your own splendor. \q So I threw you down to the ground. I made you a sight for kings to stare at.

fr.L: Ton cœur s’est élevé à cause de ta beauté ; \q tu as corrompu ta sagesse à cause de ta splendeur ; \q à terre je t’ai jeté ; devant les rois je t’ai placé, pour qu’ils te regardent.
fr.B: Ton cœur s’est enorgueilli de ta beauté ; \q tu as corrompu ta sagesse à cause de ta splendeur. \q Je t’ai jeté à terre ; je t’ai donné en spectacle aux rois.
fr.R: Tu es devenu orgueilleux parce que tu étais si beau. \q Tu as gâché ta sagesse parce que tu aimais ta propre splendeur. \q Alors je t’ai jeté par terre. J’ai fait de toi un spectacle que les rois regardent.

es.L: Se enalteció tu corazón a causa de tu hermosura; \q corrompiste tu sabiduría a causa de tu esplendor; \q a tierra te arrojé; delante de los reyes te puse, para que te miraran.
es.B: Tu corazón se llenó de orgullo por tu hermosura; \q corrompiste tu sabiduría a causa de tu esplendor. \q Te arrojé por tierra; te hice un espectáculo delante de los reyes.
es.R: Te volviste orgulloso porque eras tan hermoso. \q Echaste a perder tu sabiduría porque amabas tu propio esplendor. \q Por eso te arrojé al suelo. Hice que los reyes se quedaran mirándote.

sw.L: Moyo wako ulijivuna kwa sababu ya uzuri wako; \q uliiharibu hekima yako kwa ajili ya fahari yako; \q nilikutupa chini; nilikuweka mbele ya wafalme, ili wakutazame.
sw.B: Moyo wako ulijaa kiburi kwa sababu ya uzuri wako; \q uliiharibu hekima yako kwa ajili ya fahari yako. \q Nilikutupa chini; nilikufanya kuwa kitu cha kutazamwa na wafalme.
sw.R: Ulijivuna kwa sababu ulikuwa mzuri sana. \q Uliiharibu hekima yako kwa sababu uliipenda fahari yako mwenyewe. \q Kwa hiyo nilikutupa chini. Nilikufanya kitu ambacho wafalme wanakikodolea macho.

decisions.choice: pride in beauty and splendor: the root of the fall
decisions.reason: The charge matches verses 2-5: the king's gifts turned into pride (Proverbs 16:18).

decisions.choice: before kings I set you, to look at you: a public disgrace
decisions.reason: The fallen king is put on show, so that other kings may see him and take warning.

source.text: מֵרֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֶ֗יךָ בְּעֶ֨וֶל֙ רְכֻלָּ֣תְךָ֔ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑יךָ וָֽאוֹצִא־אֵ֤שׁ מִתּֽוֹכְךָ֙ הִ֣יא אֲכָלַ֔תְךָ וָאֶתֶּנְךָ֤ לְאֵ֨פֶר֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־רֹאֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: By [the] multitude of your iniquities, in [the] unrighteousness of your trade, you profaned your sanctuaries; and I brought out fire from your midst; it has consumed you, and I have made you ashes on the earth in [the] eyes of all who see you.

en.L: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your trade, \q you profaned your sanctuaries; \q so I brought fire out from your midst; it has consumed you, \q and I have made you ashes on the earth \q in the eyes of all who see you.
en.B: By your many sins, by the dishonesty of your trade, \q you defiled your sanctuaries. \q So I brought fire out from within you, and it devoured you; \q I turned you to ashes on the ground \q in the sight of all who were watching.
en.R: You sinned so much and were so dishonest in your trade \q that you made your holy places unclean. \q So I made a fire break out from inside you, and it burned you up. \q I turned you to ashes on the ground \q while everyone watched.

fr.L: Par la multitude de tes iniquités, par l’injustice de ton commerce, \q tu as profané tes sanctuaires ; \q alors j’ai fait sortir un feu du milieu de toi ; il t’a dévoré, \q et j’ai fait de toi de la cendre sur la terre \q aux yeux de tous ceux qui te voient.
fr.B: Par tes nombreux péchés, par la malhonnêteté de ton commerce, \q tu as profané tes sanctuaires. \q Alors j’ai fait sortir de toi un feu, et il t’a dévoré ; \q je t’ai réduit en cendres sur le sol \q sous les yeux de tous ceux qui regardaient.
fr.R: Tu as tellement péché et tu as été si malhonnête dans ton commerce \q que tu as rendu impurs tes lieux saints. \q Alors j’ai fait sortir un feu de l’intérieur de toi, et il t’a brûlé entièrement. \q Je t’ai réduit en cendres sur le sol, \q pendant que tout le monde regardait.

es.L: Por la multitud de tus iniquidades, por la injusticia de tu comercio, \q profanaste tus santuarios; \q por eso saqué fuego de en medio de ti; te ha consumido, \q y te he puesto en ceniza sobre la tierra \q a los ojos de todos los que te miran.
es.B: Por tus muchos pecados, por la deshonestidad de tu comercio, \q profanaste tus santuarios. \q Por eso hice salir fuego de dentro de ti, y te devoró; \q te convertí en ceniza sobre la tierra \q a la vista de todos los que te miraban.
es.R: Pecaste tanto y fuiste tan deshonesto en tu comercio \q que profanaste tus lugares santos. \q Por eso hice que saliera fuego de dentro de ti, y te quemó por completo. \q Te convertí en ceniza en el suelo \q mientras todos miraban.

sw.L: Kwa wingi wa maovu yako, katika udhalimu wa biashara yako, \q uliyatia unajisi mahali pako patakatifu; \q kwa hiyo nilitoa moto kutoka katikati yako; umekuteketeza, \q nami nimekufanya majivu juu ya nchi \q machoni pa wote wanaokutazama.
sw.B: Kwa dhambi zako nyingi, kwa udanganyifu wa biashara yako, \q uliyatia unajisi mahali pako patakatifu. \q Kwa hiyo nilitoa moto kutoka ndani yako, ukakuteketeza; \q nilikugeuza kuwa majivu juu ya ardhi \q mbele ya wote waliokuwa wakitazama.
sw.R: Ulitenda dhambi nyingi mno, na ulikuwa mdanganyifu sana katika biashara yako, \q hata ukayatia unajisi mahali pako patakatifu. \q Kwa hiyo nilifanya moto uwake kutoka ndani yako, ukakuteketeza kabisa. \q Nilikugeuza kuwa majivu juu ya ardhi \q huku kila mtu akitazama.

decisions.choice: your sanctuaries: Tyre's temples, or the holy place of the poem
decisions.reason: The king's sins made unclean the holy places he served, Tyre's own temples, or, in the picture of the poem, the holy mountain of God (verses 14, 16).

decisions.choice: fire from your midst: destruction from within
decisions.reason: The fire comes out of the king himself: his own sin destroys him.

decisions.choice: iniquities (L); sins (B, R)
decisions.reason: *'Awon* follows the Isaiah table.

decisions.choice: iniquidades (L); pecados (B, R)
decisions.reason: 'Avon' is worded as in Spanish Ezekiel 24:23 at L, and B and R use the plain word, as the English does.

source.text: כָּל־יוֹדְעֶ֨יךָ֙ בָּֽעַמִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלֶ֑יךָ בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔יתָ וְאֵינְךָ֖ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: All [who] know you among [the] peoples are appalled over you; sudden terrors you have become, and you will not [be] until perpetuity.

en.L: All who know you among the peoples \q are appalled over you; \q sudden terrors you have become, \q and you will be no more forever.
en.B: All among the peoples who knew you \q are appalled at your fate; \q you have come to a terrifying end, \q and you will be no more forever.
en.R: All the nations who knew you \q are shocked at what happened to you. \q You have come to a horrible end, \q and you will be gone forever.

fr.L: Tous ceux qui te connaissent parmi les peuples \q sont consternés à ton sujet ; \q tu es devenu des terreurs soudaines, \q et tu ne [seras] plus, à jamais.
fr.B: Tous ceux qui te connaissaient parmi les peuples \q sont consternés par ton sort ; \q tu as connu une fin terrifiante, \q et tu ne seras plus jamais.
fr.R: Toutes les nations qui te connaissaient \q sont choquées par ce qui t’est arrivé. \q Tu as connu une fin horrible, \q et tu as disparu pour toujours.

es.L: Todos los que te conocen entre los pueblos \q están atónitos por ti; \q terrores repentinos te has vuelto, \q y no existirás más para siempre.
es.B: Todos los pueblos que te conocían \q están horrorizados por tu suerte; \q has llegado a un final aterrador, \q y nunca más existirás.
es.R: Todas las naciones que te conocían \q están espantadas por lo que te pasó. \q Has llegado a un final horrible, \q y desaparecerás para siempre.

sw.L: Wote wanaokujua kati ya mataifa \q wameshangaa juu yako; \q umekuwa vitisho vya ghafula, \q nawe hutakuwako tena milele.
sw.B: Wote kati ya mataifa waliokujua \q wameshangaa kwa yaliyokupata; \q umefikia mwisho wa kutisha, \q nawe hutakuwako tena milele.
sw.R: Mataifa yote yaliyokujua \q yameshtuka kwa yaliyokupata. \q Umefikia mwisho wa kutisha, \q nawe umetoweka milele.

decisions.choice: the refrain of the Tyre oracles
decisions.reason: The lament ends as 26:21 and 27:36 do.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

en.B: Then the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me:
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message:

es.B: Luego la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a mí:
es.R: Luego {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje:

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD came to me (all levels, as verse 1)
decisions.reason: The settled formula, with "Then" because a new message follows.

source.text: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶל־צִיד֑וֹן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her,

en.L: Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her,
en.B: Son of man, turn to face Sidon and prophesy against her,
en.R: Son of man, turn toward Sidon. Prophesy against it.

fr.L: Fils d’homme, tourne ta face vers Sidon, et prophétise contre elle,
fr.B: Fils d’homme, tourne ton regard vers Sidon et prophétise contre elle,
fr.R: Fils d’homme, tourne-toi vers Sidon. Prophétise contre elle.

es.L: Hijo de hombre, pon tu rostro hacia Sidón, y profetiza contra ella,
es.B: Hijo de hombre, vuélvete de cara a Sidón y profetiza contra ella,
es.R: Hijo de hombre, vuélvete hacia Sidón. Profetiza contra ella.

sw.L: Mwana wa binadamu, kaza uso wako kuelekea Sidoni, ukatabiri dhidi yake,
sw.B: Mwana wa binadamu, geuka uelekee Sidoni, ukatabiri dhidi yake,
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, geuka uelekee Sidoni. Tabiri dhidi yake.

decisions.choice: son of man: a mortal, as God addresses Ezekiel
decisions.reason: See the note at 2:1.

decisions.choice: Sidon: Tyre's sister city to the north
decisions.reason: Sidon was the older Phoenician port, about twenty-five miles north of Tyre (27:8). Its gods, Baal and Astarte, were worshiped in Israel through Jezebel, daughter of a king of the Sidonians (1 Kings 16:31).

decisions.choice: set your face toward (L); turn to face (B); turn toward (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording; see 6:2. As with Tyre, Literal and Balanced keep "her" for the city and Readable says "it".

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֤י עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ צִיד֔וֹן וְנִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בַּעֲשׂ֥וֹתִי בָ֛הּ שְׁפָטִ֖ים וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: and say, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Look, I [am] against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst; and they will know that I [am] Yahweh, when I execute in her judgments and show myself holy in her.

en.L: and say, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Look, I [am] against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst; and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I work judgments in her and show {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} holy in her.
en.B: and say, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: I am against you, Sidon, and I will show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory within you. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I carry out judgments on her and show {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} holy in her.
en.R: Say, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: Sidon, I am against you. I will show {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory in you. Then people will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I punish Sidon and show that I am holy.

fr.L: et dis : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Voici, je [suis] contre toi, Sidon, et je serai glorifié au milieu de toi ; et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand j’exercerai en elle des jugements et que je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} montrerai saint en elle.
fr.B: et dis : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je suis contre toi, Sidon, et je manifesterai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire au milieu de toi. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand j’exécuterai sur elle {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements et que je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} montrerai saint en elle.
fr.R: Dis : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Sidon, je suis contre toi. Je montrerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire chez toi. Alors les gens sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand je punirai Sidon et que je montrerai que je suis saint.

es.L: y di: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: He aquí, yo [estoy] contra ti, Sidón, y seré glorificado en medio de ti; y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando haga en ella juicios y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} muestre santo en ella.
es.B: y di: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Yo estoy contra ti, Sidón, y mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria en medio de ti. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando ejecute juicios sobre ella y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} muestre santo en ella.
es.R: Di: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Sidón, yo estoy contra ti. Mostraré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gloria en ti. Entonces la gente sabrá que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando castigue a Sidón y muestre que soy santo.

sw.L: useme, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [niko] kinyume nawe, Sidoni, nami nitatukuzwa katikati yako; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapotekeleza hukumu ndani yake na kujionyesha mtakatifu ndani yake.
sw.B: useme, Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Mimi niko kinyume nawe, Sidoni, nami nitaudhihirisha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ndani yako. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapotekeleza hukumu juu yake na kujionyesha mtakatifu ndani yake.
sw.R: Sema, Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Sidoni, mimi niko kinyume nawe. Nitaonyesha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ndani yako. Ndipo watu watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapoiadhibu Sidoni na kuonyesha kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni mtakatifu.

decisions.choice: I will be glorified ... show myself holy: the LORD makes himself known through judgment
decisions.reason: When the LORD acts, his honor and his holiness are seen by all (Exodus 14:4; Leviticus 10:3; Ezekiel 20:41; 38:16).

decisions.choice: in her: the oracle turns from speaking to Sidon to speaking about it
decisions.reason: The change of person is common in the prophets.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula. The LORD's words take no quotation marks; human speech quoted inside them takes double quotes.

decisions.choice: and they will know that I am the LORD (L); Then they will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording; see 6:7.

decisions.choice: from 'ti' to 'ella'
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from speaking to Sidon (feminine 'you') to speaking about it ('in her'), and Spanish follows it.

decisions.choice: "kujionyesha mtakatifu" with no span on the reflexive
decisions.reason: "myself" is the reflexive -ji- inside the Swahili verb, which cannot take a capital, so the English span has no Swahili counterpart here.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־בָ֞הּ דֶּ֤בֶר וָדָם֙ בְּח֣וּצוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְנִפְלַ֤ל חָלָל֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ בְּחֶ֥רֶב עָלֶ֖יהָ מִסָּבִ֑יב וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will send into her pestilence and blood into her streets, and will fall [the] slain in her midst by [the] sword against her from all around; and they will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets, and the slain will fall in her midst by the sword [that is] against her from all around; and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will send plague into her and bloodshed into her streets. The slain will fall within her, struck by the sword that comes against her from every side. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will send disease on Sidon, and blood will flow in its streets. People will be killed inside the city by enemies who attack from every side. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et j’enverrai en elle la peste, et le sang dans ses rues, et les tués tomberont au milieu d’elle par l’épée [qui est] contre elle de tous côtés ; et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: J’enverrai chez elle la peste, et le sang coulera dans ses rues. Les tués tomberont au milieu d’elle, frappés par l’épée qui l’attaque de tous côtés. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: J’enverrai la maladie sur Sidon, et le sang coulera dans ses rues. Des gens seront tués dans la ville par des ennemis qui l’attaqueront de tous côtés. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y enviaré a ella peste, y sangre a sus calles, y caerán los muertos en medio de ella por la espada [que está] contra ella alrededor; y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Enviaré peste contra ella y sangre a sus calles. Los muertos caerán dentro de ella, heridos por la espada que viene contra ella por todos lados. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Enviaré enfermedades a Sidón, y la sangre correrá por sus calles. La gente morirá dentro de la ciudad a manos de enemigos que la atacarán por todos lados. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitapeleka tauni ndani yake, na damu katika njia zake, na waliouawa wataanguka katikati yake kwa upanga [ulio] dhidi yake pande zote; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitapeleka tauni ndani yake na umwagaji damu katika njia zake. Waliouawa wataanguka ndani yake, wakipigwa na upanga unaomjia kutoka kila upande. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitaleta magonjwa juu ya Sidoni, na damu itatiririka katika njia zake. Watu watauawa ndani ya mji na adui wanaoushambulia kutoka kila upande. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: pestilence and blood: disease and violent death
decisions.reason: The pair comes in Ezekiel's lists of judgments (5:17; 14:19; 38:22).

decisions.choice: pestilence (L); plague (B); disease (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *deber*.

decisions.choice: and they will know that I am the LORD (L); Then they will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording; see 6:7.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙ וְק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִכֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔ם הַשָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And there will not be again for [the] house of Israel a brier pricking and a thorn causing pain from all around them who despise them; and they will know that I [am the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a pricking brier or a painful thorn from all who are around them, who treat them with contempt; and they will know that I [am] the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The house of Israel will no longer have neighbors who treat them with contempt and hurt them like a pricking brier or a painful thorn. Then they will know that I am the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The people of Israel will no longer be surrounded by neighbors who hate them and hurt them like sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et il n’y aura plus pour la maison d’Israël d’épine qui pique ni de ronce qui fait mal, parmi tous ceux qui sont autour d’eux et qui les méprisent ; et ils sauront que je [suis] le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: La maison d’Israël n’aura plus autour d’elle de voisins qui la méprisent et la blessent comme une épine qui pique ou une ronce qui fait mal. Alors ils sauront que je suis le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le peuple d’Israël ne sera plus entouré de voisins qui le détestent et lui font du mal comme des épines pointues. Alors ils sauront que je suis le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y no habrá más para la casa de Israel zarza que pinche ni espino que cause dolor de entre todos los que [están] alrededor de ellos y que los desprecian; y sabrán que yo [soy] el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: La casa de Israel ya no tendrá vecinos que la desprecien y la hieran como una zarza que pincha o un espino que hace daño. Entonces sabrán que yo soy el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: El pueblo de Israel ya no estará rodeado de vecinos que lo odien y lo hieran como espinas afiladas. Entonces sabrán que yo soy el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wala hapatakuwa tena kwa nyumba ya Israeli mbigili uchomao wala mwiba uumizao kutoka kwa wote walio kandokando yao, wanaowadharau; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nyumba ya Israeli haitakuwa tena na majirani wanaowadharau na kuwaumiza kama mbigili uchomao au mwiba uumizao. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli hawatazungukwa tena na majirani wanaowachukia na kuwaumiza kama miiba mikali. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: a pricking brier, a painful thorn: troublesome neighbors
decisions.reason: Numbers 33:55 warns that the peoples left in the land would be "thorns in your sides". With the judgments on Ammon, Moab, Edom, the Philistines, Tyre and Sidon, those thorns are removed.

decisions.choice: verses 24-26: the close of the oracles against Israel's neighbors
decisions.reason: The six neighbors of chapters 25-28 have been judged. Before the oracles on Egypt (29-32) the LORD promises Israel peace in its own land.

decisions.choice: and they will know that I am the LORD (L); Then they will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording; see 6:7. Here the refrain names "the Lord GOD".

decisions.choice: la casa de Israel (L, B); el pueblo de Israel (R)
decisions.reason: The house of Israel is worded as the term sheet sets it through Ezekiel; here the refrain names 'el Señor DIOS', as the Hebrew does.

source.text: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בְּקַבְּצִ֣י׀אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִן־הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ בָ֔ם וְנִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָ֖ם לְעֵינֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְיָֽשְׁבוּ֙ עַל־אַדְמָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְעַבְדִּ֥י לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they have been scattered, and I show myself holy among them in [the] eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their land which I gave to my servant, to Jacob.

en.L: Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: When I gather the house of Israel out of the peoples among whom they have been scattered, and show {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} holy among them in the eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their own land which I gave to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, to Jacob.
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: When I gather the house of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will display {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holiness among them as the nations look on. Then they will live in their own land, the land I gave to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Jacob.
en.R: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered. Through them I will show the nations that I am holy. Then they will live in their own land, the land I gave to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Jacob.

fr.L: Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Quand je rassemblerai la maison d’Israël d’entre les peuples parmi lesquels ils ont été dispersés, et que je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} montrerai saint parmi eux aux yeux des nations, alors ils habiteront sur leur terre, que j’ai donnée à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, à Jacob.
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Quand je rassemblerai la maison d’Israël d’entre les nations où ils ont été dispersés, je manifesterai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} sainteté parmi eux sous les yeux des nations. Alors ils habiteront dans leur propre pays, le pays que j’ai donné à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Jacob.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Je rassemblerai le peuple d’Israël d’entre les nations où il a été dispersé. Par lui, je montrerai aux nations que je suis saint. Alors les Israélites habiteront dans leur propre pays, le pays que j’ai donné à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Jacob.

es.L: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Cuando reúna a la casa de Israel de entre los pueblos en que han sido esparcidos, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} muestre santo en ellos a los ojos de las naciones, entonces habitarán en su tierra, la que di a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, a Jacob.
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Cuando reúna a la casa de Israel de entre las naciones por donde fueron esparcidos, mostraré en ellos {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santidad a la vista de las naciones. Entonces vivirán en su propia tierra, la tierra que di a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Jacob.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Reuniré al pueblo de Israel de entre las naciones por donde fueron esparcidos. Por medio de ellos mostraré a las naciones que soy santo. Entonces vivirán en su propia tierra, la tierra que di a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Jacob.

sw.L: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nitakapoikusanya nyumba ya Israeli kutoka kwa mataifa ambayo wametawanyika kati yao, na kujionyesha mtakatifu kati yao machoni pa mataifa, ndipo watakaa katika nchi yao wenyewe niliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Yakobo.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nitakapoikusanya nyumba ya Israeli kutoka kwa mataifa walikotawanywa, nitaudhihirisha utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kati yao mataifa yakitazama. Ndipo watakaa katika nchi yao wenyewe, nchi niliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Yakobo.
sw.R: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Nitawakusanya watu wa Israeli kutoka kwa mataifa walikotawanywa. Kupitia wao nitayaonyesha mataifa kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni mtakatifu. Ndipo watakaa katika nchi yao wenyewe, nchi niliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Yakobo.

decisions.choice: the gathering of Israel: the LORD's holiness shown to the nations
decisions.reason: The promise looks ahead to chapters 34-37. Israel's scattering dishonored the LORD's name among the nations; its return will show his holiness (20:41; 36:22-24).

decisions.choice: my servant Jacob: the patriarch, and the people named after him
decisions.reason: The land was promised to Jacob (Genesis 28:13; 35:12). Isaiah and Jeremiah call the people "my servant Jacob" (Isaiah 41:8; Jeremiah 30:10).

decisions.choice: servant, at every level
decisions.reason: The prophets use "servant" for "my servant" at every level (Jeremiah 7:25; Amos 3:7), as the terms note records.

decisions.choice: Thus says the Lord GOD (L); The Lord GOD says this (B); This is what the Lord GOD says (R)
decisions.reason: The settled formula. The LORD's words take no quotation marks; human speech quoted inside them takes double quotes.

decisions.choice: siervo at every level
decisions.reason: 'My servant' keeps 'siervo' at every level, as the term sheet sets it for Moses, David and Jacob.

decisions.choice: "serviteur" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet: "serviteur" for God's named servants at every level.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi wangu" at every level
decisions.reason: As the Swahili Isaiah and Jeremiah for "my servant" in the prophets.

source.text: וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶיהָ֮ לָבֶטַח֒ וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְיָשְׁב֖וּ לָבֶ֑טַח בַּעֲשׂוֹתִ֣י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּכֹ֨ל הַשָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָם֙ מִסְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they will dwell on it in security, and they will build houses and plant vineyards, and they will dwell in security, when I execute judgments on all [who] despise them from around them; and they will know that I [am] Yahweh their God.

en.L: And they will dwell on it securely, and build houses and plant vineyards; and they will dwell securely, when I execute judgments on all who treat them with contempt from around them; and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.
en.B: They will live there in safety; they will build houses and plant vineyards. They will live in safety when I carry out judgments on all their neighbors who despise them. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.
en.R: They will live there safely. They will build houses and plant vineyards. They will live in safety when I punish all the nations around them that hated them. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God.

fr.L: Et ils y habiteront en sécurité, et ils bâtiront des maisons et planteront des vignes ; et ils habiteront en sécurité, quand j’exécuterai des jugements sur tous ceux qui les méprisent autour d’eux ; et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu.
fr.B: Ils y habiteront en sécurité ; ils bâtiront des maisons et planteront des vignes. Ils habiteront en sécurité quand j’exécuterai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements sur tous leurs voisins qui les méprisent. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu.
fr.R: Ils y vivront en paix. Ils construiront des maisons et planteront des vignes. Ils vivront en sécurité quand je punirai toutes les nations voisines qui les détestaient. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu.

es.L: Y habitarán en ella seguros, y edificarán casas y plantarán viñas; y habitarán seguros, cuando yo haga juicios en todos los que los desprecian a su alrededor; y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.B: Vivirán allí seguros; construirán casas y plantarán viñas. Vivirán seguros cuando yo ejecute juicios contra todos sus vecinos que los desprecian. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios.
es.R: Vivirán allí en paz y seguridad. Construirán casas y plantarán viñas. Vivirán seguros cuando yo castigue a todas las naciones de su alrededor que los odiaban. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios.

sw.L: Nao watakaa ndani yake salama, na kujenga nyumba na kupanda mashamba ya mizabibu; nao watakaa salama, nitakapotekeleza hukumu juu ya wote wanaowadharau walio kandokando yao; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao.
sw.B: Wataishi humo kwa usalama; watajenga nyumba na kupanda mashamba ya mizabibu. Wataishi kwa usalama nitakapotekeleza hukumu juu ya majirani wao wote wanaowadharau. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao.
sw.R: Wataishi huko salama. Watajenga nyumba na kupanda mashamba ya mizabibu. Wataishi kwa usalama nitakapoyaadhibu mataifa yote yanayowazunguka yaliyowachukia. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao.

decisions.choice: build houses and plant vineyards: a settled, blessed life
decisions.reason: The covenant curse was to build and plant and not enjoy it (Deuteronomy 28:30). The promise reverses it (Isaiah 65:21; Jeremiah 29:5; Amos 9:14).

decisions.choice: securely: without fear of enemies
decisions.reason: Living securely in the land is the blessing promised in Leviticus 25:18-19, and it returns in 34:25-28.

decisions.choice: and they will know that I am the LORD (L); Then they will know (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain follows the settled wording; see 6:7.
